title: Splinter
tagline: Your beam splits on everything it touches. Aim into the crowd.
description: A survival run where the weapon fires itself and the only thing you control is where you stand. Your beam refracts: every enemy it passes through splits it into two dimmer beams heading off at an angle, and those split again. Fired into open space it does almost nothing; fired into a packed crowd it fans out into a cascade that clears the screen. Levelling up offers three upgrades, and nearly all of them change how the light comes apart rather than how hard it hits. You will die. What you earned buys permanent upgrades for the next one.
author: HexCave
howToPlay: Move with WASD or the arrow keys. On a touch screen, drag anywhere and your figure follows your thumb.
The beam fires on its own, in the direction you are facing — the mouse aims it on a desktop.
Every enemy the beam passes through splits it in two, each half dimmer than the last. Firing into a crowd is worth many times firing into space.
Killing things drops prisms. Collect them to level up, and pick one of three upgrades each time.
Most upgrades change the refraction: how many times it splits, how wide the split, how much survives each one.
Enemies damage you on contact. When your health is gone the run ends, and the prisms you collected buy permanent upgrades before the next one.
goal: Survive as long as you can, and bank prisms for the run after this one.
